summary_1line: Hanuman defeats Ravana’s five generals and devastates their armies outside Lanka after Ravana orders them to capture the mysterious monkey.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hanuman leaps through the sky and crashes onto Durdharsha’s chariot like lightning, smashing the horses and hurling the general to the ground.
Hanuman uproots a massive Sala tree and swings it down upon Virupaksha and Yupaksha, crushing the two demon generals.
Bleeding but furious like the rising sun, Hanuman lifts a mountain peak and hurls it onto Praghasa and Bhasakarna, destroying them amid beasts and trees.
